ai_summary: This document is a standard regulatory intimation from India Motor Parts & Accessories Limited (IMPAL) to the stock exchanges, announcing a Board of Directors meeting on July 30, 2026. The primary purpose of this meeting is to consider and approve the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. This is a routine compliance filing with no immediate material financial impact or red flags, though the subsequent release of the financial results will be crucial for investor assessment.
